termos.secao_servico_texto: KORRE is an offline-first app to support vehicle, fuel, cost and productivity management.
termos.secao_dados_texto: The app may store fuel entries, estimated/real consumption, maintenance and operational data to improve KORRE Audit calculations.
termos.uso_dados_anonimos_texto: KORRE may generate anonymous and aggregated statistics on fuel, consumption, costs, maintenance and vehicle usage. These statistics may be used to improve the app, create market reports and develop future features. KORRE does not share name, CPF, email, phone, password, plate or individually identifiable data in statistical reports. The user can enable or disable participation in privacy settings.
termos.secao_desativar_texto: You can change this consent in Settings > Privacy and data.

politica.secao_coleta_texto: KORRE stores local profile, vehicle, finance, maintenance and settings data for app operation.
politica.secao_abastecimento_texto: The app may store fuel entries, fuel type, total value, liters, unit price, current KM, calculated consumption and maintenance costs.
politica.secao_nunca_titulo: Data never included in commercial reports
politica.secao_nunca_texto: Name, CPF, email, phone, password, hash, plate, photo, exact location and identifiable individual history are never included in commercial reports.
politica.secao_desativar_texto: Settings > Privacy and data > disable anonymous data usage.
